from core.models import AttendanceLog, Child
from datetime import date

# Find the child
try:
    child = Child.objects.get\(admission_number=''D0515''\)
    print\(f''Child Found: {child.name} \(Admission: {child.admission_number}\)''\)
    print\(''='' * 60\)
    
    # Query November 2025 attendance
    start_date = date\(2025, 11, 1\)
    end_date = date\(2025, 11, 30\)
    
    attendance_records = AttendanceLog.objects.filter\(
        child=child,
        attendance_date__gte=start_date,
        attendance_date__lte=end_date
    \).order_by\(''attendance_date''\)
    
    total_count = attendance_records.count\(\)
    print\(f''Total Attendance Count for November 2025: {total_count}''\)
    print\(''='' * 60\)
    
    if total_count > 0:
        print\(''Attendance Records:''\)
        print\(''-'' * 60\)
        for record in attendance_records:
            checkout = record.check_out_time if record.check_out_time else ''Not checked out''
            print\(f''Date: {record.attendance_date} | Check-in: {record.check_in_time} | Check-out: {checkout}''\)
    else:
        print\(''No attendance records found for November 2025.''\)
        
except Child.DoesNotExist:
    print\(''Child with admission number D0515 not found.''\)
")
